Plugin: media_kit_libs_windows_audio 1.0.9 (MIT)
https://github.com/media-kit/media-kit/tree/main/libs/windows/media_kit_libs_windows_audio

x64 and ARM64 libmpv: LGPL bundles, 2026-10-22-488fec0789
https://github.com/zhongfly/mpv-winbuild/releases/tag/2026-10-22-488fec0789
Build recipes: https://github.com/zhongfly/mpv-winbuild
mpv source: https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv/tree/488fec0789
The bundles also provide video decoders; Mornye uses their audio API.
The x64 build targets the baseline architecture, without the x86-64-v3 requirement.
Both include wasapi-exclusive-buffer for devices that glitch after stream resets.
LGPL license: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-2.1.html
